clientChanges: Shared visible-state Python policy replaces the demo combat baseline. No server damage/status/reward formula was changed or duplicated.
Always replace a selected skill when it is no longer offered by current legal set_skill actions, even if an affordable replacement has a lower heuristic score.

Account for visible self-damage text and energy cost in skill preference; do not count damage to self as outgoing damage.
All returned decisions are actual offered legal actions; no dice outcome, hidden random state or battle result is predicted.
